_about: Accounts, the days allotted to each, the repurposing rules and the dark days. Read by build-kit.mjs to make calendar.html. One piece is written once in calendar.csv; everything it is repurposed to comes from the rules here, never from a second row.

vd-ig.label: Venture Drafters Instagram
vd-ig.role: The main channel. Every piece starts here unless it is a LinkedIn text post.

vd-fb.label: Venture Drafters Facebook page
vd-fb.role: Automatic: turn on 'Share to Facebook' in Instagram once. No separate posting.

yt.label: YouTube
yt.role: Every Monday Reel as a Short, the same evening. One long video a month from December.

vd-li.label: Venture Drafters LinkedIn page
vd-li.role: Friday only: reshare the week's strongest post from Palak's LinkedIn, with one line. No original posts.

p-li.label: Palak's LinkedIn
p-li.role: The main written channel. Two a week; the fortnightly PDF carousel is one of the two.

p-ig.label: Palak's Instagram
p-ig.role: Monday Reel as a Collab post (one post, on both grids). Thursday carousel shared to Stories.

p-fb.label: Palak's Facebook
p-fb.role: Share the Monday Reel once a week from the Venture Drafters page. Nothing else.

wa-st.label: WhatsApp Status (Palak)
wa-st.role: Tuesday and Thursday about 9 am, Saturday optional. Three a week at most.

wa-note.label: Monthly note (opted-in only)
wa-note.role: Second Wednesday, 10:30 to 11:30 am, only to people who said yes. No note in March.

fam.label: Family WhatsApp Status
fam.role: Once a month at most: the month's most-sent Reel on your father's and sister's Status. Never sent to groups, never as messages.

irl.label: In person
irl.role: Events and visits. Stories from the floor, with the host's credit.
